map_role: damaged but operational freighter salvage and rail export yard
density_profile: clustered machinery and settlement on both edges, discontinuous trestles and editable central voids
strong_motifs: entered steel freighter hull and breached cargo hold
three separated elevated freight trestle segments
interesting_relationships: damaged suspension spans still support usable alternate flyways
ship cabin/hull distinguishable from dockside and crane foundations
broken cargo transfer stages coexist with working salvage sorting and rail dispatch
human-editable underworks directly under the active sorting route
authoring_affordances: unbuilt trestle joints and accessible return paths
procedural_exemplar_value: Reusable broken-trestle load paths, supports, intact/damaged handoff relationships and two-level recovery, without filling intentional expansion voids.
similarity_avoidance: Unlike Bracken Rift's two gorge bridges, Orison's working circular indexer and Hollow Strake's geology-first fault, this map uses visibly failed short trestle spans, a salvaged hull and clustered machine-yard chambers.
